The applicant apprehends arrest in connection with Crime Register No.
54 of 2021 registered at Dadar Coastal Police Station, District Raigad.

sentences.text: The prosecution case, in short, is that on 6 December 2021, the police officials of Dadar Sagari Police Station received secret information that a tempo bearing registration No. MH/14/JL/5579 was carrying prohibited contraband while travelling from Mumbai 3-aba-1008-2022.doc highway towards Pen Taluka.
Acting on this information, the police staff laid in wait on the highway.
Around 4:15 p.m., the tempo was intercepted, and the driver was directed to halt.
The tempo was brought to the police station, and two panch witnesses were called.

On checking the boxes loaded in the tempo,
packets of Vimal Pan Masala Gutka worth Rs. 25,27,323/- were found.
The said gutka is a contraband item and prohibited.
On this basis, an FIR came to be registered against the applicant.

3. The learned Advocate for the applicant submitted that this Court, by order dated 13 April 2022,
had granted protection to the applicant.
The applicant has not misused the liberty granted by that order and has extended full cooperation during the investigation.
The investigation has now concluded, and the charge-sheet was filed on 22 June 2022.
Hence, the interim protection deserves to be confirmed.

4. The learned APP opposed the application, submitting that the allegations are of a serious nature,
and in view of the gravity of the offence, the relief of pre-arrest bail ought not to be granted.
5. The applicant was granted interim protection by order dated 13 April 2022.
During this entire period, the applicant has abided by the conditions imposed and has not misused the liberty.
This shows that the applicant has respected the process of law.
6. The investigation is already complete.
The charge-sheet has been filed on 22 June 2022.

Therefore, the custodial interrogation of the applicant is no longer required.
3-aba-1008-2022.doc 7.
The allegations relate to transportation of contraband gutka.
The material is already seized by the police, and nothing further is required to be recovered from the applicant.
Hence, further custody will not serve any purpose.
8. The offence alleged is of a commercial nature.
The punishment prescribed is not of such a nature that denial of pre- arrest bail becomes an absolute necessity.
9. The applicant has roots in society.
There is nothing to suggest that he is likely to abscond or tamper with the prosecution evidence.
10. The object of Section 438 of Cr.P.C. is to protect a person against unnecessary arrest when investigation can proceed without custody.
In the present case, that object stands satisfied.

11. Hence, following order:

a) In the event of arrest in connection with Crime Register No.54 of 2021 registered with Dadar Coastal police station, District Raigad for offences punishable under Sections 420, 328, 272, 273 of IPC, and under Section 59 of the Food Safety &
Standard Act, 2006, the applicant be released on bail on furnishing P.R. bond of Rs.25,000/-, along with one or two sureties in the like amount.

entities.text: Dadar Coastal police station, District Raigad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: b) The applicant shall remain present before the concerned police station, as and when called by the investigating officer.

3-aba-1008-2022.doc c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any witness acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer.

d) The applicant shall not obstruct or hamper the police investigation and not to play mischief with the evidence collected or yet to be collected by the police.
e) The applicant shall, at the time of execution of the bond, furnish his address and mobile number to the investigating officer, and the Court concerned, and shall not change the residence till the final disposal of the case.
12. The Anticipatory Bail Application stands disposed of in above terms.

(AMIT BORKAR, J.)
